project.name: AI Knowledge Assistant
project.description: An early-stage academic research assistant for searching, ranking, summarizing, and eventually answering questions over scholarly paper metadata.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Describes the AI Knowledge Assistant product vision, current FastAPI stack, planned academic paper search APIs, and roadmap toward research briefs and grounded question answering.

nodes.name: FastAPI Application
nodes.summary: Defines the FastAPI app, request schema, health endpoint, and paper search endpoint that delegates discovery to the RAG pipeline and adds ranking explanations.

nodes.name: PaperSearchRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for paper searches, including query, result limit, starting year, and optional academic source selection.

nodes.name: health
nodes.summary: Returns a simple service status payload for the /health endpoint.

nodes.name: search_papers
nodes.summary: Handles paper search requests, calls the research-paper pipeline, and enriches each returned paper with ranking reasons.

nodes.name: GET /health
nodes.summary: Health check route for confirming the API process is running.

nodes.name: POST /papers/search
nodes.summary: Search route that accepts a topic or research question and returns normalized, ranked academic paper metadata.

nodes.name: Research Paper Pipeline
nodes.summary: Coordinates source selection, calls scholarly source loaders, ranks combined paper results, and maps raw metadata into short response summaries.

nodes.name: _paper_score
nodes.summary: Builds a sortable score tuple using abstract availability, citation count, and publication year.

nodes.name: rank_papers
nodes.summary: Sorts paper metadata by the scoring tuple and returns the requested number of top results.

nodes.name: summarize_paper_metadata
nodes.summary: Normalizes a paper response payload and truncates long abstracts into a short practical summary.

nodes.name: find_research_papers
nodes.summary: Queries selected academic sources, merges results, ranks them, and returns summarized metadata.

nodes.name: Academic Source Loaders
nodes.summary: Contains HTTPX clients and normalization helpers for Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex search responses.

nodes.name: _authors_from_semantic_scholar
nodes.summary: Extracts author names from Semantic Scholar paper metadata.

nodes.name: _authors_from_openalex
nodes.summary: Extracts display names from OpenAlex authorship records.

nodes.name: _openalex_abstract
nodes.summary: Reconstructs OpenAlex inverted-index abstracts into readable text.

nodes.name: _normalize_semantic_scholar
nodes.summary: Maps Semantic Scholar API data into the app's common paper metadata shape.

nodes.name: _normalize_openalex
nodes.summary: Maps OpenAlex work data into the app's common paper metadata shape.

nodes.name: search_semantic_scholar
nodes.summary: Calls the Semantic Scholar paper search API with optional publication-year filtering and returns normalized paper records.

nodes.name: search_openalex
nodes.summary: Calls the OpenAlex works API with optional publication-date filtering and returns normalized work records.

nodes.name: Ranking Explanation Helpers
nodes.summary: Provides user-facing reasons for why a paper ranked well, based on summary availability, citation count, and year.

nodes.name: explain_ranking
nodes.summary: Creates a short list of ranking reasons for a normalized paper result.

nodes.name: Python Requirements
nodes.summary: Lists the Python runtime dependencies: FastAPI, Uvicorn, HTTPX, and Pydantic.

nodes.name: Future Plans
nodes.summary: Expands the product roadmap around scholarly source coverage, access status, ranking, PostgreSQL/pgvector, summaries, briefs, QA, Indonesian support, and later OCR.

nodes.name: RAG Model And Embedding Summary
nodes.summary: Documents RAG architecture options, local and hosted generation models, embedding candidates, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation metrics.

nodes.name: Docker Desktop Release Notes
nodes.summary: A local notes file about Docker Desktop releases; currently not connected to the application runtime.

tour.title: Start With The Product Direction
tour.description: Read the README first to understand that the repository is shifting from local document RAG toward a topic-bounded academic paper discovery assistant.

tour.title: Inspect The API Surface
tour.description: Open the FastAPI entrypoint to see the available health and paper search routes plus the request model used by the search endpoint.

tour.title: Follow Search Orchestration
tour.description: Trace how the search endpoint calls the pipeline, which fans out to selected sources, ranks results, and summarizes metadata.

tour.title: Review Source Normalization
tour.description: Look at the loader module to understand how Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex responses are fetched and normalized into a shared paper shape.

tour.title: Compare Roadmap Against Current Code
tour.description: Use the planning documents to see the next architectural steps: access status, PostgreSQL and pgvector, multilingual output, research briefs, and grounded QA.
